scientific_integrity: Proof supplies exact primal/dual optimality certificates. Reproducible rational checks support the proof but do not constitute independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Explicit symmetric pair-synergy game, 2 <= n <= 7, a >= 0 and b > 0; uniform random entry, full one-step voluntariness, fixed expected Shapley terminal allocation and half squared Euclidean edge norm. No claims for larger n, other norms or models. Unindexed equivalent results may exist.
title: A seven-player limited-liability transition for closest voluntary Shapley payment flows
